did_you_know.text: Solet is finely sifted flour, while frankincense is an aromatic resin that can be burned. The offering therefore combined food with a fragrant scent.
The word azkarah is related to the Hebrew root meaning “remember,” and here it refers to the portion set aside as a memorial before God. The priest burned only a handful, not the entire offering.
In the Bible, the word devash can mean either bee honey or a sweet fruit syrup, such as date syrup. That is why translations may render it differently.
Salt was used in the ancient world to preserve food, so it could symbolize permanence and loyalty. In the Bible, the phrase “covenant of salt” became a symbol of a lasting covenant.
“Roasted fresh grain” describes young cereal kernels roasted over a fire and crushed. It is an offering from the first harvest, before the grains had fully matured.
